headline: Fuack
title: Fuack | Surfing Slam Water Pal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Fuack is a tiny Water Pal with Watering, Handiwork and Transporting all at level one. Its partner skill, Surfing Slam, makes it body surf into an enemy and slam them. You can find it in the early game, with most spawns in the Verdant Brook area. Fuack drops Leather and Aquatic Pal Fluids every time. Do you run a Fuack at base? Comment below!
description: Fuack in Palworld 1.0: early game Water Pal with Watering, Handiwork and Transporting level 1 and the Surfing Slam partner skill. Checked on Pindrop and palworld.gg in November 2026.
